Someone once said that real love never truly fades. At forty, after meeting so many people along the way, I know that to be true. There are two women I will never forget. Without warning, they still cross my mind every single day. The first passed away from an illness; if she were still here, I have no doubt we would still be together. The second showed me a depth of love I had never experienced, standing by me even at my absolute lowest—yet I pushed her away. By the time I realized what she meant to me, it was too late. No matter who enters my life, those two will never be erased from my memory. I cherish every moment we shared, and I will carry them with me until my last breath. 

Please, cherish the people you love. Hold them close and appreciate them today, because you truly don't know what you have until it is gone—and you never know which moment might be your last together.
